catalogMeta.label: Ten and Some More (Teen Numbers)
catalogMeta.description: A DOUBLE frame whose top half arrives full — that is one ten — and the child places the remaining ones to make a teen number 11-19. CCSS K.NBT.1 composition: 14 is ten and four more. Concrete manipulative; no microphone needed.

fullData.title: Ten and Some More
fullData.description: Build teen numbers from 11 to 15 by starting with a full ten frame and adding more counters.
